Metadata.title: Conexión Caribe · Your Punta Cana trip, organized from start to finish
Metadata.description: Local concierge in Punta Cana, Bávaro and Bayahíbe: vacation rentals, airport transfers, excursions and services. You book the flight, we take care of everything else.

Hero.title: You book the flight. We take care of everything else.
Hero.subtitle: Stays, transfers, excursions and services coordinated by a local team. One contact, one itinerary.
Hero.trust2: Support in English, Spanish and French
Hero.imageAlt: White sand beach, palm trees and turquoise sea in the Dominican Caribbean

Excursions.title: Experiences to live the Caribbean
Excursions.lead: A selection to get you started. Before you book, we confirm availability, schedules and price.
Excursions.waMessage: Hi Conexión Caribe. I'm interested in this excursion: {name}.
Excursions.note: All experiences are subject to quote and availability.

saonaClasica.title: Classic Saona Island
saonaClasica.tagline: Turquoise water, palm trees and an unforgettable getaway.
saonaClasica.detail: Shared excursion; itinerary subject to availability.

saonaVip.title: Saona Island VIP · 4 beaches
saonaVip.tagline: A more exclusive Caribbean, at your own pace.
saonaVip.detail: Premium options and tours of several beaches.

catalina.title: Catalina Island
catalina.tagline: An invitation to discover the sea and its reefs.

buggies.title: Buggy adventure
buggies.detail: Guided activity, subject to age and safety rules.

partyBoat.title: Party boat
partyBoat.tagline: Music, Caribbean vibes and fun on the water.
partyBoat.detail: Group experience for adults and families, depending on the option.

santoDomingo.title: Cultural Santo Domingo
santoDomingo.detail: Tour of the Colonial Zone and its cultural landmarks.

zipline.title: Zip line & adventure
zipline.tagline: Adrenaline and nature in one experience.
zipline.detail: Horseback riding, parasailing and Scape Park also on request.

MoreExperiences.title: And much more, tailored to you

HowItWorks.title: Your trip, planned in three steps
HowItWorks.lead: No more juggling ten websites or coordinating providers on your own.
HowItWorks.step1Text: Dates, how many people and what you'd like to do. On the website or via WhatsApp.
HowItWorks.step2Text: We confirm availability and prices with our local partners.
HowItWorks.step3Text: Your itinerary in one place and local support throughout your stay.

Services.title: More than excursions
Services.lead: One connection to organize everything, from your airport arrival to the special details of your stay.

CtaBand.title: Already have your dates?
CtaBand.text: Tell us when you arrive and who's traveling. We'll reply on WhatsApp with a tailor-made proposal.

WhatsApp.defaultMessage: Hi Conexión Caribe. I'd like to plan my trip.
